review_basis: Frozen report input, grounded element statements, formal plan, deterministic P/I/V AST, validation output and solver output. Z3 success was not treated as semantic correctness. Rejected cases were reviewed at the element layer and their formalization attempt chains; their formal ratings are not_evaluable because the pipeline emitted no final formal artifact. A same-model heterogeneous-prompt dual review (DUAL_REVIEW.json) runs as a second opinion.

rating_scale.pass: faithful to the report and correctly scoped
rating_scale.partial: core direction is correct but a material condition, scope or observable relation is weakened or omitted
rating_scale.fail: misclassified, contradicted, circular or missing a critical report condition
rating_scale.not_evaluable: the pipeline did not emit the corresponding final artifact

summary.interpretation: Engineering completion held at 6/10 (third consecutive 60% batch), and the type/unit fabricated-definition family — the largest live-3 bottleneck — is gone from the rejection column (Hybra and Intuition candidates this time, Intuition saved by the live-4 repair prescription). Of the live-4 prompt's two targets, the cross-multiplication feedback worked and the duplicate-predicate ban did not (Hybra still collapsed two facts; the ban also cannot reach the already-frozen reporting-only check). The four rejections are one confirmed misfire family (hex protocol constant 0x811, second independent case, parsimony threshold now met and the pre-registered fix direction applies), two correct catches whose single repair moved in the right direction but hit the one-retry deadline, and one repair-discipline failure whose prescribed feedback is mechanically unreachable at the frozen retry budget.

Ekubo_3FTodhsvBkM.notes: State correspondence on the Transfer event source: P = spender != from plus the invocation context, I = (event emitted and spender != from) implies event_source == from, V = the indexer-facing mismatch. Distinct grounded predicates; impact cited on event_source_address.

GTE_Perps_and_Launchpad.engineering: rejected (numeric P bound hidden by non-comparison predicate)
GTE_Perps_and_Launchpad.notes: Correct catch. p_transfer_total_fee_share_zero states totalFeeShare becomes 0 via a transfer; the faithful form is a comparison total_fee_share == 0 with the text literal, which the DSL supports. Attempt 1 omitted the source; the single repair added it as a truth predicate, so the gate correctly rejected again. The element layer also bundled the action with its result state instead of selecting the clean state fact.

Hybra_Finance.notes: Live-4's own target failed here: rhybr_defaults_zero and gauge_immutable_rhybr share the identical rhybr_address == zero_address predicate, so the immutability fact stops being represented (the rule's prescribed escape — move it to assumptions — was not taken). I and V are faithful: condition rHYBR == 0 with rewards present, relation withdrawal_completed, V the failed withdrawal. Repaired from 'zero-address I condition not observable' on the single retry.

Intuition_2VUsxVJwReb.notes: The type/unit family member rejected in live-3 is now a candidate: repaired to the cross-multiplied form with no fabricated derived symbol. P terms are distinct grounded booleans. I is weakened relative to the report: the claim is 100% of eligible rewards, the relation only demands received * floor_denominator > eligible * floor_numerator (strictly above the floor), so any under-payment above the floor satisfies I. V matches the floor-penalty impact.

Merkl_T4ExvutBBXC.notes: Three distinct grounded P booleans; relation restates the intent text directly (creation rejected and no pull for an ended campaign); the report's pulled-then-idle mechanism is captured by funds_pulled_for_ended_campaign, and unresolved/limitations honestly defer the fee impact and the observation-status ambiguity.

Monetrix_L3gNZDymiju.engineering: rejected (numeric P literal changed -> local repair made no change)
Monetrix_L3gNZDymiju.notes: Misfire, second independent case of the live-3 family: 0x811 is a storage-slot/protocol constant, but the literal scanner parses it as 2065 and demands it as a bound, so the direction-correct ge 0 predicates are rejected as 'literal changed'. The repair resubmitted the plan byte-identically (no-change), whose prescribed feedback is unreachable at --formal-retries 1. Parsimony threshold (>= 2 independent cases) is now met; the pre-registered fix direction (hex prefix treated as protocol identifier) applies.

Panoptic_Hypovault.notes: Single P predicate first_fulfill_total_assets == 1 with the report-text literal 1; condition reuses it, relation deposit_fulfillment_completed, V the zero-share mint. Clean and minimal; no repair needed (3 model calls).

Panoptic__Next_Core.notes: P partial: the tuple-order fact p_getemas_returns_order is encoded as returned_spot_ema != returned_fast_ema, a fabricated inequality — order is a binding fact, not a value relation. I partial: the buggy rotation (eons<-spot, slow<-fast, fast<-slow) is the CONDITION and blended_tick_correct the relation, so I reads 'under the wrong binding the blended tick must still be correct' — vacuous in a fixed system; the required correspondence (identity binding) is never stated as the relation. V does cite the incorrect-price-signal impact. Repaired from 'trivial self-comparison predicate' on the single retry.

Sequence__Transaction_Rails.engineering: rejected (invalid quantity binding -> local repair made no change)
Sequence__Transaction_Rails.notes: Attempt 1 failed validation of the conservation template's quantity binding; the single repair resubmitted the plan byte-identically, so the gate's rejection stands. The no-change prescription written in live-4 never reaches the model at the frozen retry budget (it is generated only for an attempt after the no-change is detected).

SukukFi_syLyTBz5KNA.engineering: rejected (numeric P source missing from plan)
SukukFi_syLyTBz5KNA.notes: Correct catch with a feedback gap: two unselected numeric-bearing precondition statements (the 1:1 asset/share rate and the MAX_VAULTS_PER_SHARE_TOKEN cap of 10) are demanded by the gate, and the retry hint for 'numeric P source missing' does not name the missing statement IDs, so the model's single repair adjusted predicates instead of adding sources. The DSL can express both demanded comparisons, so the gate is satisfiable; the model was never told which sources it dropped.
